reasons.correctness: Port, properties (prefix currency.fixed-rates), adapter (case-insensitive, PLN=1) and toPln (HALF_UP scale 2) all match the interface. The missing rate throws BusinessRuleTranslatableException with the key and ISO code as argument. Hidden tests 5/5.
reasons.convention_fit: Port in currency/port and adapter in currency/adapter, inside the existing currency feature package. Explicit constructor injection. The new key is in both messages_en and messages_pl. Unit tests use MockitoExtension with no Spring context and were run with -Ptest.
reasons.design_fit: CurrencyConversionService depends only on ExchangeRatePort. The properties class follows the existing RegistryProperties/SandboxProperties pattern. The yml block adds only the needed rates. The case-insensitive stream lookup is minimal. No parallel mechanism or stray layer.
reasons.test_quality: The adapter test covers the configured rate, lowercase matching, PLN without config, and an unknown code. The service test pins HALF_UP rounding (3.955*10) and the exception's key and args. Neither test covers the null isoCode branch.
reasons.graph_use: One graph query listed the *Port/*Adapter files and led to VatRegistryPort/BialaLista, which the new code followed. The feature package, properties pattern and test layout were found with find/grep/cat.
